import numpy as np

def {{fn_name}}(X, y, lr=0.01, epochs=1000):
    X = np.asarray(X, dtype=float)
    y = np.asarray(y, dtype=float)
    n, d = X.shape
    w = np.zeros(d)
    b = 0.0
    for _ in range(epochs):
        pred = X @ w + b
        err = pred - y
        w -= lr * (X.T @ err) / n
        b -= lr * err.mean()
    return w, b
